proposed_widenings.name: passive_triggered_item_hazard
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has an always-on deterministic hazard that damages qualifying creatures on touch and again at turn end while they hold or carry it. Existing magic-item families only cover passive grants, activated uses, and triggered reactions.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

proposed_widenings.name: destroy_target
proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke's failed-save branch removes the target entirely rather than dealing damage or applying a condition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains.

proposed_widenings.name: save_gate.targetHasTypeDisadvantage
proposed_widenings.justification: The activated save is modified by the target's creature type, which current save-gate shapes do not express.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has Disadvantage on the save.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because no honest existing magic-item family represents the talisman's automatic contact/holding hazard. The passive +2 spell attack rider would fit on its own.
